cards.title: Requirement Coverage Matrix
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when the prompt has >=3 explicit deliverables/sub-questions that each need their own evidence and conclusion. Skip for single-metric or single-question tasks.

cards.title: Metric Contract and Threshold Lock
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when the task defines exact thresholds/formulas/cohort filters (e.g., top X%, metric > Y). Skip when analysis is purely qualitative or no hard cutoff is required.

cards.title: Segmentation Triad
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when you must explain a performance gap via subgroup comparison (target vs control, quantiles, cohorts). Skip when no segmentation is needed.

cards.title: Driver Ranking with Consistency Checks
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when the question asks for driver ranking or factor importance among multiple candidates. Skip for simple descriptive summaries.

cards.title: Quantified Recommendation Card
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when the prompt explicitly asks for recommendations/optimization actions with quantitative targets. Skip if the task only asks diagnosis/measurement.

cards.title: Sensitivity and Robustness Mini-Test
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when conclusions depend on assumptions (budget/pricing/allocation/model weights) and need robustness checks. Skip for purely historical descriptive analysis.

cards.title: Data Availability and Fallback Protocol
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY after data-access anomalies appear (missing table/column, empty or inconsistent query outputs). Skip when data pipeline is healthy.

cards.title: Final Report Hardening Checklist
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY at final write-up time (pre-Terminate) for report hardening. Skip during early exploration/calculation steps.

cards.title: Time Window and Leakage Guard
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY for time-based prediction/forecasting or past-vs-future evaluation where leakage risk exists. Skip for static cross-sectional analysis.

cards.title: Denominator and Unit Consistency
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when computing rates/shares/percentages where denominator/unit consistency affects correctness. Skip if outputs are absolute counts only.

cards.title: Path Minimum Output Contract
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when multiple valid analysis paths exist and each requirement must satisfy a minimum output contract. Skip for single-path, narrowly specified tasks.

cards.title: Anchor Number Cross-Check
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when exact anchor numbers/tolerance checks are critical to scoring or acceptance. Skip when directional conclusions are sufficient.

cards.title: Missing Value and Imputation Policy
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when key metrics rely on joins/features with non-trivial missing values and fill policy can change conclusions. Skip when missingness is negligible.

cards.title: Claim-Evidence Linking
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when final claims/recommendations must be explicitly tied to numeric evidence. Skip for intermediate scratch analysis.

cards.title: Strategy Roadmap Operationalization
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when the deliverable is an executable roadmap (owner/timeline/KPI/guardrail), not just high-level advice. Skip for diagnosis-only tasks.

cards.title: Causal Claim Countercheck
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when asked to explain causes/drivers and you must avoid correlation-as-causation errors. Skip for pure reporting or pure prediction tasks.

cards.title: Requirement Coverage Ledger
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY for long multi-step prompts with ordered deliverables (first/then/finally) where missing one step hurts completeness. Skip if exp-da-001 already covers a short task sufficiently.

cards.title: Forecast Uncertainty and Scenario Bands
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY for planning under uncertainty that needs scenario bands/upside-downside decisions. Skip for deterministic retrospective analysis.

cards.title: Small-Sample Filter Fallback
cards.when_to_use: Use ONLY when strict filtering yields a sparse cohort (e.g., very small N) and you still need stable conclusions with fallback logic. Skip when sample size is adequate.
